entities.name: Ja'far ibn Ali
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jaʿfar ibn ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib was a son of Ali and Umm al-Banin. He was named by Ali after the latter's brother, Ja'far ibn Abi Talib. The younger Ja'far was one of the companions of Husayn in the Battle of Karbala, where he was martyred on Ashura alongside his brothers Abbas, Abdullah and Uthman.
